events.credibility_reason: The formal statement was AI-autoformalised with hand-rolled definitions of φ-mixing, stationarity and variance, and no human has compared them with the classical ones; the only audit is machine-written; the author says he cannot judge it; the 13,000-line construction has had no public human reading after 37 days.
events.ai_basis: This entire repository was machine-written by AI assistants at the direction of Tom Adamczewski. The counterexample construction and Lean disproof in this repository were obtained by GPT-6 Astra.

why: The Adamczewski/GPT-6 Astra repository is scored whole: the statement is the Ibragimov–Iosifescu conjecture, whose two parts are the CLT and the invariance principle, and a single stationary φ-mixing sequence with finite variance and Var(Sₙ)→∞ for which the CLT fails refutes part (i) and, since the invariance principle implies the CLT at time 1, part (ii) as well; that implication is elementary, so the prose-only treatment of (ii) does not reduce scope. The Peligrad φ₁<1 conjecture is not in the title and is treated as a related problem. Verification is unreviewed: a clean Lean build plus AI-written audits are not digestion (F7, F8), and the object is non-explicit, so not checkable. Credibility is doubtful rather than not_credible: the doubt is specific (AI-autoformalised hand-rolled definitions, author cannot judge), but there is no identified error, and the silence is only 37 days. AI role is generated per the README's explicit attribution. The pre-1990 results are restricted cases (linear-variance regime, added uniform integrability, assumed CLT plus linear variance); the other papers concern other mixing classes, other hypotheses, or unknown content, and are variant or none.
doubts: The whole call rests on the Lean definitions being faithful to the classical ones; if they are not, the event settles a formal variant. The repository's README was read only through a WebFetch summary. Whether a human-supplied 'sketch' was given to the run is unknown, which could lower the AI role to assisted. Herrndorf 1983 (conditional on the CLT) could arguably be none rather than case; it is pre-snapshot and does not affect the outcome.
